title: Preserve important StateInner holders until registration evidence is collected
outcome: Bounded StateInner evidence can retain a relevant long holder until a pending registration reports it, despite many intervening short completed holds.
acceptance: Independently concur on a bounded retention design before implementation, preserving nonblocking observer release and explicit unknown/loss semantics.
A deterministic fixture models a long overlapping hold followed by more than 256 short unrelated completions before evidence collection and verifies the retained evidence policy.
Existing bounds, pending identity, retry, durability, launcher decisions and mutex/poison behavior remain unchanged under credited focused verification and independent review.
